title: Who Was Shanta?
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda 1.8-10 and 1.17 (Critical Edition; vulgate 1.9-11, 1.18)

captions.instagram:
Many of us heard that Rama had an elder sister, Shanta, given by King Dasharatha to his friend, the king of Anga. The Srimad Bhagavatam tells it that way. In Valmiki's Ramayana (Critical Edition), Shanta is the daughter of Lomapada, king of Anga, and the wife of the sage Rishyashringa. The prophecy says the king of Anga "will have a daughter named Shanta", and Dasharatha himself says to Lomapada: "Let YOUR daughter Shanta come to my city with her husband." Both tellings are told with devotion.

Had you heard Shanta was Rama's sister? Tell us where you first heard it 👇 Jai Shri Ram!

captions.youtube_description:
Many of us heard that Rama had an elder sister, Shanta, given by King Dasharatha to his friend, the king of Anga. The Srimad Bhagavatam tells it that way. In Valmiki's Ramayana (Critical Edition), Shanta is the daughter of Lomapada, king of Anga, and the wife of the sage Rishyashringa. The prophecy says the king of Anga "will have a daughter named Shanta", and Dasharatha himself says to Lomapada: "Let YOUR daughter Shanta come to my city with her husband." Both tellings are told with devotion.

Had you heard Shanta was Rama's sister? Tell us where you first heard it 👇 Jai Shri Ram!

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda 1.8-10 and 1.17 (Critical Edition; vulgate 1.9-11, 1.18)
Verses:
• Srimad Bhagavatam: to his friend Romapada, Dasharatha gave his own daughter Shanta, whom Rishyashringa married — Bhagavata Purana 9.23.7-8
• Anga suffers a drought under King Lomapada; the Brahmins say: bring Rishyashringa and give him the maiden Shanta — 1.8.11-16
• Rain falls as Rishyashringa arrives; the king of Anga gives him Shanta in marriage; he lives there with his wife Shanta — 1.9.28-32
• Sanatkumara's prophecy: Dasharatha will be friends with the king of Anga, and HE will have a daughter named Shanta — 1.10.3
• In the prophecy Dasharatha tells Lomapada: I am childless; may Shanta's husband perform my rite — 1.10.5
• Dasharatha to Lomapada: let your daughter Shanta come to my city with her husband — 1.10.19
• The women of Ayodhya's inner palace welcome Shanta; she stays; after the horse-sacrifice she leaves with Rishyashringa; then Rama is born — 1.10.28-29; 1.17.5-6
• Nowhere in the CE is Shanta called Dasharatha's daughter or Rama's sister (she is named only in 1.8-10 and 1.17) — whole text searched (all 7 kandas)
